# ULFGFD-Slim

Face Detection · `ulfgfd-slim_240x320` · DX-APP Python example

Face Detection model, evaluated on WiderFace.

**Input** 320 × 240 × 3 · **Dataset** WiderFace · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![ULFGFD-Slim output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models ulfgfd-slim-320
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/face_detection/ulfgfd/ulfgfd-slim_240x320/ulfgfd-slim_240x320_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/ulfgfd-slim_240x320.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_face.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target ulfgfd-slim_240x320_sync   # once
./bin/ulfgfd-slim_240x320_sync \
  -m assets/models/ulfgfd-slim_240x320.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_face.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | AP(Easy) | AP(Med) | AP(Hard) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 70.64 | 54.50 | 25.63 |
| Q-Lite | 70.19 (−0.45) | 54.18 (−0.32) | 25.46 (−0.17) |
| Q-Pro | 70.97 (+0.33) | 54.71 (+0.21) | 25.76 (+0.13) |

WiderFace · difference vs Raw in brackets.
